nodes.label: Help article: DJ libraries
nodes.rationale: Documents how to import and manage DJ libraries (Rekordbox, Engine DJ, Serato, Traktor, Apple Music, M3U) and keep them in sync with GLUE

nodes.label: DJ libraries: import and follow
nodes.rationale: Support for importing Rekordbox, Engine DJ, Serato, Traktor, Apple Music, and M3U; libraries are followed live with GLUE Home

nodes.label: Engine DJ two-way sync
nodes.rationale: Beat grids, cues, saved loops and song info (title, artist, album, genre, comment, label, year, rating) synced between GLUE and Engine DJ; writes happen when Engine DJ is closed after backup
